title: Sound! Euphonium Releases SunFes Performance Scene
content: Sound! Euphonium anime released the performance scene of Kitauji High School in the Sunrise Festival (SunFes for short) marching band event that appeared in the first part of the Sound Euphonium Final Movie . The second part of the movie is set to release in Japanese theaters on September 11, 2026.

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of Spring 2026 Is Finally Getting Serious (And Somehow Even Funnier)
content: Crunchyroll ‘s darkest anime of Spring 2026, after five episodes of world-building and constant twists, has finally laid out its trajectory and is now getting serious while still keeping humor at the forefront.

title: Let Me Fix You Anime Delayed After Grooming Allegations of Buta Productions Co-Founder FAR
content: A user on X (formerly Twitter ) named Maryco (@Maryco02_) posted on Saturday to accuse Federico Antonio Russo (also known as FAR ), the co-founder and co-producer of Europe-based animation studio Buta Productions , of allegedly grooming her.

title: One Piece Creator’s Recommended Manga Bounced Back From The Brink of Cancellation
content: Thanks to the success of several long-running and iconic serializations such as Dragon Ball , One Piece , Naruto , Bleach, etc., Weekly Shonen Jump became the best-selling manga magazine of all time. Launched in 1968, this famous magazine has serialized countless incredible manga over the decades.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Releases Episode 5 Climax on YouTube to Stream for Limited Time
content: Witch Hat Atelier anime has released around 6 minutes of the Episode 5 climax, featuring the fight against the dragon and Qifrey’s appearance. The episode was originally released worldwide on April 27, and the anime ranked first for the first time after its release.

title: The One Piece Anime Remake Unveils 300-Minute February 2027 Global Debut
content: Netflix announced on Tuesday that The One Piece , Wit Studio 's remake of the One Piece anime for the streaming service, will begin streaming "all seven episodes" of its first season worldwide in February 2027.
